msg: Hello, we're a family from Toronto staying at Hotel San Pedro de Majagua on the islands. Our kids are 9 and 11. What can they do? We parents would snorkel.
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

That sounds like a lovely family day on the reefs! Since you’re staying at San Pedro de Majagua, the island-based options are convenient.

- *Your 9-year-old* can try the PADI Bubble Makers program: a supervised introduction to diving in a pool or very shallow water (maximum 2 m), with a dedicated PADI instructor. It doesn’t provide certification. The team arranges the details and booking. - *Your 11-year-old* is above the Bubble Makers age range (8–10), and can join the snorkeling tour, which is open to ages *6 and up*. - *You parents* can join the snorkeling tour too: it includes two reef snorkeling sessions, equipment, insurance, and a PADI professional. Pick-up at San Pedro de Majagua is included. Lunch isn’t included.

You can book snorkeling here: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/snorkeling-already-on-the-island/25?language=en

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• Bubble Makers (kids 8-10): 123 USD · 137 USD
• Snorkeling Tour: 45 USD · 50 USD

Would you like me to connect you with a team advisor about arranging Bubble Makers for your 9-year-old?

msg: Yes, please connect us about the Bubble Makers. Meanwhile, can our 11-year-old do the mini course instead of snorkeling?
reply:
Yes—your 11-year-old can do the dive mini-course instead of snorkeling. The minimum age is 10, and minors must be accompanied by a parent or responsible relative.

For Bubble Makers for your 9-year-old, the program is for ages 8–10 and takes place in a pool or very shallow water (maximum 2 m), with a dedicated PADI instructor. The team arranges its details and booking. Would you like me to connect you with a team advisor about it?

✅ Includes: hotel pick-up (if there is maritime/boat access), insurance, snorkeling gear and a PADI professional accompanying the activity.

msg: Just to confirm: the mini course is only for our 11-year-old, one person. The 9-year-old will do Bubble Makers. Is that right?
reply:
Yes, that’s right: the dive mini-course is for your 11-year-old only, and your 9-year-old can do Bubble Makers. The mini-course is available from age 10; Bubble Makers is for ages 8–10 and takes place in a pool or very shallow water (maximum 2 m) with a dedicated PADI instructor.

Would you like me to connect you with a team advisor to arrange Bubble Makers?

msg: Yes, please connect us with the advisor.
reply:

They will contact you shortly. Thanks! :)
